analysis_plan.unit: fresh world; both record variants and all three arms remain paired
analysis_plan.bootstrap: 10000 whole-world resamples; descriptive unadjusted 95% percentile intervals
analysis_plan.format: Explanation arms have identical user messages and schemas differing only in property key order. Validate actual serialized output order and nonempty reasoning text.
analysis_plan.invalid_answers: Retain and stop on any returned schema, order, empty-reasoning, or technical failure; no resampling or continuation.
analysis_plan.interpretation: This compares constrained output order, not a unique internal mechanism. Text after an answer cannot revise the scored first answer, but the model knows the full schema and can anticipate later text. Reasoning text is not evidence of faithful internal computation.
analysis_plan.decision: no scientific pass gate; no outcome-dependent extension

uncertainty: 10,000 whole-world bootstrap resamples, seed 981723; descriptive, unadjusted 95% intervals. The sampling unit is the world, not an API call. There are 12 fresh worlds from the same task family and one model; this is not a cross-model replication. Degenerate intervals do not establish certainty or equivalence. Full-plan unscorable bounds are point-estimate bounds, not confidence intervals.
interpretation: If all outputs comply, lower answer-first accuracy than answer-only can show harm before a written explanation is generated, but the requested task and output schema also differ. Lower reasoning-first accuracy than answer-first supports an effect of generation order, potentially including early answer commitment, in this interface, not a unique effect of text self-conditioning or an identified internal mechanism. Reasoning-field nonemptiness does not establish substantive or faithful reasoning. The first structured answer is final; no later answer inside reasoning is scored as a revision. An accurate result in all arms of this small study does not establish equivalence. The changed structured interface does not directly explain earlier unconstrained results. No scientific pass threshold or outcome-dependent sample extension is applied.
failure_policy: Any returned invalid output is retained and never resampled. Wrong schema, wrong key order, empty required reasoning, or any other returned invalidity causes a technical/output-manipulation failure even if other answers comply. Compliant-subset estimates and bounds in this JSON are audit diagnostics only when interpretation_allowed is false; do not use them to claim a successful manipulation or an answer-order effect.
